title: A museum entrance
topic: Two people are talking at a museum entrance. What will the man take out of his bag?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 博物館の入口で二人が話しています。男の人は、かばんから何を出しますか。
turns.translation: Two people are talking at a museum entrance. What will the man take out of his bag?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 大きいかばんは、あちらのロッカーに入れてください。小さい物は持って入れます。
turns.translation: Please put large bags in those lockers. You may take small items inside.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 分かりました。ノートを持って行ってもいいですか。学校で今日のことを書きます。
turns.translation: All right. May I take my notebook? I have to write about today at school.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: はい。ノートは大丈夫です。でも、建物の中で食べたり飲んだりしないでください。
turns.translation: Yes, a notebook is fine. But please don't eat or drink inside the building.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: お茶とお菓子はかばんに入れたままにします。写真を撮ってもいいですか。
turns.translation: I'll leave my tea and sweets in the bag. May I take photographs?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 写真は撮れません。入口の写真は、お帰りの時に撮ってください。
turns.translation: You can't take photos inside. Please take any photos of the entrance when you leave.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: じゃ、カメラもここに置きます。ノートに絵を描くのは大丈夫ですね。
turns.translation: Then I'll leave my camera here too. It's okay to draw in the notebook, right?

options.label: ノート
options.rationale: He gets permission to use his notebook, then plans to draw in it. Food, drink and camera remain behind.

options.label: カメラ
options.rationale: Because photography inside is prohibited, he leaves this behind too.

explanation: Worked example: combine the permitted notebook with the later decisions to leave the drinks, food and camera. The notebook is the only listed item to take inside.
